path.aria-label: How We Score Fire Risk: Gaseous Fuel

g.aria-label: PSI-159 : gas flames, normal + inverse: Ethane, Butane, & Propane
Burn Time Split all tests into 3 equal groups (tertiles)
Peak Temperature Split all tests into 3 equal groups (tertiles)
Combustion Score = (burn time tertile + peak temp tertile) ÷ 2
Example (CFI-G Test 21106 C1, 50% butane): burn time 63 s → High (2) + peak burner temp 242 °C → Mid (1) Score = (2 + 1) ÷ 2 = 1.5 → MEDIUM RISK
